findings.description: When n is 0 and the start date falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the function returns the start date itself instead of moving to the following Monday, which violates the requirement that n == 0 should return the following Monday on a weekend.
findings.evidence: add_business_days(date(2024, 5, 25), 0) where 2024-05-25 is a Saturday, returns 2024-05-25 instead of 2024-05-27.

review.summary: The function fails to correctly handle the case where n=0 and the start date falls on a weekend, as it returns the weekend date instead of the following Monday.
